environment: Separate temporary app copy; synthetic source/target Supabase PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage and REST services on localhost

Workspace members can read SOP; outsider cannot read SOP or project
Only restored Quality approver passes final-approval authorization RPC
Restored product steps load in correct order through authenticated REST
Restored private photo is readable through authenticated Storage
All source rows remain unchanged; target business rows match archive (startup health logs and profile refresh timestamps excluded)
4 application hooks on Auth/Storage and 19 Storage policies recovered from encrypted metadata
Browser sign-in opens recovered workspace dashboard
Recovered SOP opens in editor and Save & close persists edited title
Recovered mobile process builder shows two ordered steps and private photo

limitations: Synthetic credentials were created separately with preserved UUIDs; production Auth migration is not implemented by this backup.
Baseline Supabase grants were established before fixture migrations, rather than adding permissions during recovery.
Notification health logging and profile refresh timestamps can legitimately change after target startup.
Realtime gateway, SSO/MFA, full review/signature lifecycle, production-scale media and external integration recovery were not exercised.
